content.title: Upgrades #2
content.body:
Preparing for the next bossfight:

    - Diamond ranged/melee weapons

    - Sunshine (Champion Drop)

    - §ltip for Arcums:§r obtain the Summon Spirit Horse spell to have a portable Quick Fingers mount
    §lBaubles:
    - Greater Empty Ring (Used to craft better potion rings)
    - Sirius Charm
    - Celestial Charm
    - Diamond-Tipped Arrow
    - Faelis Claws
    - Poison Stone
    - Heavy Arrow Quiver
    - Heavy Bolt Quiver
    §lOverworld Exploration:
    - Exploring and clearing §ounderground dungeons §ris recommended in this stage of progression, because of the high xp yield alongside the abundance of weapons, enchantments, and blaze rods inside chests.
